liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Black Peter** (2 reviews): Reviewer disagrees with a prior review and enjoys this Black Peter, despite it being their least favorite song; Reviewer says Garcia put in half-hearted effort on Black Peter, especially the 'let's go run and see' verses [13][14]
- **Picasso Moon** (1 review): Reviewer calls Picasso Moon the show's highlight, a great version of an otherwise mediocre song [13]
- **Samson And Delilah** (1 review): Garcia's second solo in Samson is strong and the band sounds tight [18]
- **Eyes Of The World** (1 review): Eyes has a lovely, mellow intro that the reviewer finds too brief [18]

## Setlist highlights

- **NFA chant/tuning**: back after 167 archived shows (759 days); rare: 3 archived performances [23]

## The recordings

- **gd1991-09-17.110644.dmtx.hansokolow.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 166 min; rated 4.33/5 by 3 [1]
- **gd1991-09-17.150293.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 164 min [6]
- **gd1991-09-17.167539.me88.rogosa.flac2496**: source not stated; 19 songs; 161 min [10]
- **gd1991-09-17.nak300.gidley.121837.flac2448**: audience recording; 20 songs; 157 min [2]

## Around the show

- Reviewer attended most MSG shows and recalls this one as uninspired, with Garcia seemingly not engaged and wanting rest in Marin [17]
- Pre-encore Not Fade Away chant has a cool phasing effect as the audience drifted out of sync [10]
- Reviewer finds the show decent but not among the best of the Madison Square Garden run [13]
- Reviewer says Garcia seemed disengaged throughout the MSG run, except the Marsalis show, until Hornsby helped before Boston [14]
- Reviewer says Garcia emerged from a slump on the 16th and 17th, stronger than early in the run, including 9-10-91 [15]
- Reviewer argues against tepid reception: Garcia's playing is not listless and neither is anyone else's [19]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1991-09-17.110644.dmtx.hansokolow.flac16**: transferred by hansokolow; source: This is a matrix of these sources: SBD: shnid=12847 (SBD: DAT> CD> EAC> SHN) // DAUD: shnid=97390 (B&K 4011 110∫ ORTF > Neumann BS 48i-2> Modified Sony TCD… [1]
- **gd1991-09-17.150293.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: taped by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering By Charlie Miller  June 7, 2020; source: SBD > Cassette Master (TDK SA-X100) [6]. Also: Recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; several sets of masters combined to complete the show [6]
- **gd1991-09-17.167539.me88.rogosa.flac2496**: taped by Dan Rogosa; transferred by Charlie Miller, Mark Goldey; source: 2x Senn ME88s (stand, OTS) > TCD-D3 > line out > TCD-D5 (Dolby B) [10]. Also: Pitch corrected against Dan's DAT, which supplies Box of Rain's opening seconds, a patch for a tape flip in Space, and NFA chant [10]
- **gd1991-09-17.nak300.gidley.121837.flac2448**: taped by Ted Gidley; transferred by Andrew F.; source: OTS AUD: 2x Nakamichi CM300 w/CP4 shotguns > Sony TC-D5M > Maxell MXS 90/100, w/no Dolby. Taped by Ted Gidley. [2]
